Project 01 · NASA Space Apps Hackathon 2025

AstroBloom

Overview

A website prototype for a plant bloom tracking tool, made by a team of 5 at the NASA Space Apps Hackathon 2025. It was my first team project like this.

My role

I did most of the design and built the website, including the interactive globe. A teammate made the pulsing location markers.

Tools

Figma, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Design decisions

A dark, simple interface so the globe and the data stand out. Pink is used for the data and buttons. The page starts with a calm home screen and an Explore button, then moves into the data view.

What the interface does

Pick a country, move through the months with a slider or Play, read the vegetation (NDVI) trend with a prediction line, and open an AI prediction panel. It also has an upload field for MODIS files.

Status

Working prototype. It still has a bug: there is no way back to the home page from the project page.

Open live site View code on GitHub

Privacy note: the live site shows placeholders instead of real team member names and photos, to protect people's privacy.

Project 02 · Personal concept

Nacre Aero

Overview

A weather app concept in the Frutiger Aero style, which I like: glossy glass panels, bubbles, sky and grass, and betta fish floating across the screen.

Purpose

To try out how a nostalgic, cheerful style can look in a phone app.

Flow

Welcome screen, choose your city, five-day forecast.

Status

App creation in process. Three screens are designed so far.

Project 03 · Poster

MP3 Forever

Overview

A poster inspired by early-2000s music players and Y2K graphics.

Design decisions

A bright pink background with black stars, a barcode, a spec line ("1000 songs / 5GB") and wide pixel-style type. A flat MP3 player drawing with a tangled cable fills the centre.

Project 04 · Brand exercise

Shift Coffee House

Overview

A rebranding exercise for a coffee shop, with a logo, a colour palette and merchandise mockups, made in Canva in 2023, one of my first design projects.

Design decisions

A warm brown palette called "Bright Retro", a rounded retro wordmark with a shadow, and a steaming cup as the symbol. I also tried the logo in other colours while learning.

Main logo and merchandise board, then three colourway tests.
